extra_vocab.en: a person or company that buys something
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於合約、收據、保固與採購文件，指「買東西的一方」，語氣比 buyer 正式。常和 seller（賣方）成對出現。

example.en: The purchasers must sign the form before the goods are shipped.
example.zh: 買方必須在貨物出貨前簽署這份表格。

example.en: We sent the price list to every potential purchaser.
example.zh: 我們把價目表寄給了每一位潛在買家。

example.en: The warranty covers only the original purchaser of the product.
example.zh: 保固只涵蓋產品的原始購買者。

example.en: A first-time purchaser can get ten percent off this item.
example.zh: 首次購買的顧客可享這項商品九折。

examples.en: The purchaser agrees to pay the full price within thirty days.
examples.zh: 買方同意在三十天內付清全額。

examples.en: The purchaser will receive an email once the order is confirmed.
examples.zh: 訂單確認後，購買者會收到一封電子郵件。

examples.en: Each purchaser must show a receipt to return the item.
examples.zh: 每位購買者都必須出示收據才能退貨。

similar.diff: buyer 較口語，也常指公司的採購人員；purchaser 較正式，常見於合約與文件。

example.en: The buyer asked the seller to lower the price.
example.zh: 買方要求賣方降價。

similar.diff: customer 是上門的顧客，不一定已經買了東西；purchaser 一定是已購買或將購買的一方。

example.en: Every customer receives a small gift with the order.
example.zh: 每位顧客訂購時都會收到一份小禮物。

example.en: The seller will deliver the goods by next Friday.
example.zh: 賣方會在下週五前送貨。

example.en: Our supplier raised the price of steel again this year.
example.zh: 我們的供應商今年又調漲了鋼材價格。

example.en: We pay each vendor within thirty days of the invoice.
example.zh: 我們在發票開立後三十天內付款給每家廠商。

derived.link: purchaser = purchase + -r，買東西的人，像 write → writer

extra_vocab.en: a small bag that people use to carry money and small things
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於購物、失物招領與旅遊情境。美式英語的 purse 多指女用手提包，英式英語則多指放錢的小錢包。

example.en: The store sells leather purses in six different colors.
example.zh: 這家店販售六種顏色的皮革皮包。

example.en: She bought a leather purse as a gift for her mother.
example.zh: 她買了一個皮革皮包送給母親。

example.en: Visitors may not carry a purse into the laboratory.
example.zh: 訪客不得攜帶皮包進入實驗室。

example.en: A lost purse was handed in at the front desk.
example.zh: 有人把一個遺失的皮包送到了櫃檯。

examples.en: The shop sells purses, belts, and other small leather goods.
examples.zh: 這家店販售皮包、皮帶和其他小型皮件。

examples.en: Please keep your purse close to you in the crowded station.
examples.zh: 在擁擠的車站裡請把皮包帶在身邊。

examples.en: I think I left my purse in the taxi.
examples.zh: 我想我把皮包忘在計程車上了。

confusable.diff: pursue 是動詞，意思是「追求、從事」；purse 是名詞「皮包」，拼法相近。
confusable.usage: purse 是名詞；pursue 是及物動詞，後面直接接受詞，如 pursue a career。

example.en: She decided to pursue a career in finance.
example.zh: 她決定從事金融方面的職業。

similar.diff: wallet 是放紙鈔與卡片的皮夾，男女都用；purse 在美式英語裡多指女用手提包。

example.en: He keeps his credit cards in his wallet.
example.zh: 他把信用卡放在皮夾裡。

similar.diff: handbag 是較大的手提包；purse 在英式英語裡指小錢包。

example.en: She carried a black handbag to the interview.
example.zh: 她拿著一個黑色手提包去面試。

example.en: Please leave your bag at the front desk.
example.zh: 請把您的包包放在櫃檯。

example.en: He put the receipt in his jacket pocket.
example.zh: 他把收據放進外套口袋。

example.en: Please show your membership card at the entrance.
example.zh: 請在入口處出示您的會員卡。

senses.en: a small bag that women carry to hold money and other things

example.en: She took her phone out of her purse during the meeting.
example.zh: 她在會議中從皮包裡拿出手機。

senses.en: a small case for coins and bills
senses.distinguish: 英式英語中 purse 多指放錢的小錢包；美式多指手提包。

example.en: She counted the coins in her purse to pay the fare.
example.zh: 她數了數錢包裡的硬幣來付車資。

extra_vocab.en: a person who makes plans, or a book used to write plans
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於活動籌辦與時間管理情境，如 event planner（活動企劃）、daily planner（每日行事曆）。看前後文判斷是「人」還是「記事本」。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: plan 加 -er 時 n 要重複寫成 planner，和 runner、beginner 的規則一樣。

example.en: The planners are checking the venue for next month's event.
example.zh: 企劃人員正在確認下個月活動的場地。

example.en: Our event planner booked the hotel ballroom for the party.
example.zh: 我們的活動企劃訂下了飯店宴會廳來辦派對。

example.en: A financial planner can help you save for retirement.
example.zh: 理財規劃師可以幫你為退休存錢。

example.en: I write all my meetings in my daily planner.
example.zh: 我把所有會議都寫在每日行事曆裡。

examples.en: The planner sent us a draft schedule for the conference.
examples.zh: 企劃人員寄給我們研討會的時程草案。

examples.en: Our city planner will explain the new road project today.
examples.zh: 我們的都市規劃師今天會說明新的道路工程。

similar.diff: organizer 指負責籌辦、整理的人或團體，也可指整理用具；planner 側重事前的規劃。

example.en: The organizer sent the final schedule to all guests.
example.zh: 主辦人把最終時程寄給了所有賓客。

example.en: Please check the schedule before you book a room.
example.zh: 訂會議室前請先確認時間表。

example.en: The agenda for tomorrow's meeting has five items.
example.zh: 明天會議的議程有五個項目。

example.en: Please add the meeting to the shared calendar.
example.zh: 請把這場會議加到共用行事曆上。

derived.link: planner = plan + n + -er，做規劃的人，n 要重複，像 runner、beginner

senses.en: a person whose job is to make plans for events or projects

example.en: The planner checked every detail before the opening ceremony.
example.zh: 企劃人員在開幕典禮前確認了每個細節。

senses.en: a book or app used to write down plans and dates
senses.distinguish: 指記事本時常與 daily、weekly 連用，指的是物品而不是人。

example.en: She opened her planner to find a free time slot.
example.zh: 她打開行事曆找一個空的時段。

extra_vocab.en: a person whose job is to write computer programs
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於科技公司徵才、專案會議與軟體開發情境，如 computer programmer。指寫程式的人，現在也常用 developer 或 engineer 稱呼。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: programmer 的 m 要寫兩個（program + m + er），不是 programer。

example.en: Our programmers are fixing the error in the system.
example.zh: 我們的程式設計師正在修正系統的錯誤。

example.en: He works as a computer programmer for a bank.
example.zh: 他在一家銀行擔任電腦程式設計師。

example.en: We need to hire a programmer for the new project.
example.zh: 我們需要為新專案僱用一位程式設計師。

collocations.zh: 自由接案的程式設計師

example.en: A freelance programmer built our company website last year.
example.zh: 一位自由接案的程式設計師去年建了我們公司的網站。

examples.en: The programmer explained how the new software works.
examples.zh: 程式設計師說明了新軟體的運作方式。

examples.en: Ask the programmer if the update can be ready by Friday.
examples.zh: 請問問程式設計師，更新能不能在星期五前完成。

examples.en: We are looking for an experienced programmer to join our team.
examples.zh: 我們正在找一位有經驗的程式設計師加入團隊。

similar.diff: developer 範圍更廣，包含設計與開發，現在在職稱中更常見；programmer 側重寫程式。

example.en: The software developer tested the new app all week.
example.zh: 這位軟體開發人員整個星期都在測試新的應用程式。

similar.diff: engineer 常負責設計系統架構；programmer 側重把功能寫成程式。

example.en: The software engineer designed the structure of the new system.
example.zh: 這位軟體工程師設計了新系統的架構。

example.en: Please update the software before you start work.
example.zh: 開始工作前請先更新軟體。

example.en: The new system saves us about two hours a day.
example.zh: 新系統每天幫我們節省約兩小時。

example.en: The team wrote the code in just two days.
example.zh: 團隊只花了兩天就寫好這段程式碼。

derived.link: programmer = program + m + -er，寫程式的人，m 要重複，像 runner、planner

extra_vocab.en: to read a text carefully to find and fix mistakes
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於文件、報告、廣告文案與電子郵件，如 proofread the report before sending。重點是找出拼字與標點錯誤，不是重寫內容。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: proofread 是不規則變化，過去式與過去分詞拼法不變（proofread），但發音變成 /ˈpruːfred/。

example.en: She always proofreads the report before she sends it out.
example.zh: 她總是在寄出報告前先校對。

example.en: I proofread the contract twice before the meeting yesterday.
example.zh: 我在昨天會議前把合約校對了兩次。

example.en: He is proofreading the brochure for spelling mistakes now.
example.zh: 他現在正在校對這本手冊的拼字錯誤。

example.en: Please proofread the document carefully before you print it.
example.zh: 列印前請仔細校對這份文件。

example.en: Proofread your email for mistakes before you click send.
example.zh: 按下寄出前，請先校對電子郵件有沒有錯誤。

example.en: Could you proofread the draft by tomorrow morning?
example.zh: 你可以在明天早上前校對這份草稿嗎？

examples.en: An editor proofreads every article before it is published.
examples.zh: 編輯在每篇文章刊出前都會校對。

examples.en: All printed materials must be proofread by two staff members.
examples.zh: 所有印刷品都必須由兩位員工校對。

confusable.diff: proof 是名詞「證明、證據」；proofread 是動詞「校對」，只是前半部相同。
confusable.usage: proofread 是及物動詞，後面直接接文件，如 proofread a report；proof 通常用在 proof of purchase 這類名詞片語。

example.en: Please keep the receipt as proof of purchase.
example.zh: 請保留收據作為購買證明。

similar.diff: edit 會修改內容與結構；proofread 只找出並改正拼字、標點等錯誤。

example.en: The manager will edit the speech before the conference.
example.zh: 經理會在研討會前修改這份演講稿。

similar.diff: review 是整體檢視內容；proofread 是逐字檢查錯誤。

example.en: Please review the budget report before Friday's meeting.
example.zh: 請在星期五會議前檢視這份預算報告。

example.en: I sent the first draft to my manager.
example.zh: 我把初稿寄給了我的經理。

example.en: I found three spelling mistakes in the report.
example.zh: 我在報告裡找到三個拼字錯誤。

example.en: Please save the document before you close the file.
example.zh: 關閉檔案前請先儲存文件。

example.en: There is a small typo in the title of the report.
example.zh: 報告的標題有一個小小的打字錯誤。

extra_vocab.en: a person who walks in a street or on a road
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於交通、路況公告與城市規劃，如 pedestrian crossing（斑馬線）、pedestrian zone（行人徒步區）。也可當形容詞，表示「行人專用的」。

example.en: Many pedestrians gather near the station during lunch time.
example.zh: 午餐時間有許多行人聚集在車站附近。

example.en: Cars must stop completely at the pedestrian crossing ahead.
example.zh: 車輛必須在前方的行人穿越道完全停下。

example.en: A pedestrian bridge connects the station to the mall.
example.zh: 一座人行天橋連接車站和購物中心。

example.en: Cars are not allowed in the pedestrian zone downtown.
example.zh: 市中心的行人徒步區禁止汽車進入。

examples.en: Please watch for pedestrians when you drive near the school.
examples.zh: 在學校附近開車時請注意行人。

examples.en: The street is closed to cars but open to pedestrians.
examples.zh: 這條街禁止汽車通行，但行人可以通行。

examples.en: A pedestrian was slightly hurt in the accident this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上的事故中有一名行人輕傷。

similar.diff: passerby 指剛好路過的人，不一定在過馬路；pedestrian 指在道路上步行的人。

example.en: A passerby helped the driver call for assistance.
example.zh: 一位路人幫駕駛叫了救援。

example.en: Please do not park your bike on the sidewalk.
example.zh: 請不要把腳踏車停在人行道上。

example.en: Use the crosswalk when you cross the main street.
example.zh: 穿越大馬路時請走斑馬線。

example.en: Traffic is heavy near the station every morning.
example.zh: 車站附近每天早上車流都很多。

example.en: The driver stopped the bus at the red light.
example.zh: 司機在紅燈前把公車停了下來。

example.en: A pedestrian must wait for the green light to cross.
example.zh: 行人必須等綠燈才能穿越馬路。

example.en: The city plans to build a new pedestrian walkway.
example.zh: 市政府計畫興建一條新的行人步道。

extra_vocab.en: a guess about the future based on numbers, or an image shown on a screen
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於財務報告與業績會議，如 sales projection（銷售預測）。也可指把影像投射到螢幕上，要看前後文判斷。

example.en: The projections were based on last year's sales figures.
example.zh: 這些預測是根據去年的銷售數字做出的。

example.en: The sales projection shows steady growth over three years.
example.zh: 銷售預測顯示未來三年會穩定成長。

example.en: It is hard to make a projection without enough data.
example.zh: 沒有足夠資料就很難做出預測。

example.en: Please turn on the projection screen in the meeting room.
example.zh: 請打開會議室的投影螢幕。

examples.en: According to our projections, profits will rise by eight percent.
examples.zh: 根據我們的預測，利潤將成長百分之八。

examples.en: The finance team updated the projection after the new order.
examples.zh: 財務部門在收到新訂單後更新了預測。

confusable.diff: protection 是「保護」，拼法相近但意思完全不同。

example.en: The protection of customer data is our top priority.
example.zh: 保護客戶資料是我們的首要工作。

confusable.diff: production 是「生產、產量」，和預測無關。

example.en: Production at the factory will increase next month.
example.zh: 工廠的產量下個月將會增加。

similar.diff: forecast 是最常見的「預測」，用於業績、天氣；projection 強調根據現有數字推算。

example.en: Our sales forecast for the next quarter is positive.
example.zh: 我們下一季的銷售預測是樂觀的。

similar.diff: estimate 是大概的估算或估價單；projection 是對未來的推算。

example.en: The estimate for the repair work is three hundred dollars.
example.zh: 這項維修工作的估價是三百美元。

example.en: The report shows a clear trend in online shopping.
example.zh: 報告顯示線上購物有明顯的趨勢。

example.en: The marketing budget is higher than last year.
example.zh: 今年的行銷預算比去年高。

example.en: Please check the figures in the table again.
example.zh: 請再確認表格裡的數字。

example.en: The company expects strong growth in the next year.
example.zh: 公司預期明年會有強勁的成長。

derived.link: projection = project + -ion，把「預估、投射」變成名詞，像 act → action

senses.en: a guess about what will happen, based on numbers

example.en: The sales projection for next year looks very positive.
example.zh: 明年的銷售預測看起來非常樂觀。

senses.en: an image shown on a screen or wall
senses.distinguish: 出現在簡報、會議室設備情境，指畫面或影像。

example.en: The projection on the wall was too small to read.
example.zh: 牆上的投影太小，看不清楚。

extra_vocab.en: related to the making or selling of medicine
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於新聞、求才與貨運情境，如 pharmaceutical company（製藥公司）。也可當名詞，指藥品，通常用複數 pharmaceuticals。

example.en: Many pharmaceuticals must be kept in a cool, dry place.
example.zh: 許多藥品必須存放在陰涼乾燥的地方。

example.en: The pharmaceutical company opened a new plant in the south.
example.zh: 這家製藥公司在南部開了一間新工廠。

example.en: The pharmaceutical industry hires many researchers every year.
example.zh: 製藥產業每年都會僱用許多研究人員。

example.en: Pharmaceutical products must be kept in a cool place.
example.zh: 藥品必須存放在陰涼的地方。

examples.en: The pharmaceutical firm plans to launch its new drug in June.
examples.zh: 這家製藥公司計畫在六月推出新藥。

examples.en: She has worked in pharmaceutical sales for five years.
examples.zh: 她從事製藥業務已經五年。

examples.en: These cartons contain pharmaceutical supplies for the hospital.
examples.zh: 這些紙箱裡裝的是要給醫院的藥品用品。

similar.diff: medical 涵蓋醫學與醫療的範圍；pharmaceutical 專指藥品與製藥。

example.en: The hospital bought new medical equipment last month.
example.zh: 醫院上個月買了新的醫療設備。

example.en: The new drug has passed all the safety tests.
example.zh: 這種新藥已通過所有安全測試。

example.en: Take this medicine twice a day after meals.
example.zh: 這種藥請在飯後每天吃兩次。

example.en: The clinic opens at eight every weekday morning.
example.zh: 診所每個平日早上八點開門。

example.en: You need a prescription to buy this medicine.
example.zh: 買這種藥需要處方。

derived.link: pharmac- 是「藥」的字根，pharmacy 是賣藥、配藥的地方
pharmac + -ist，做藥學專業的人，像 artist、scientist

example.en: He works for a pharmaceutical firm in the science park.
example.zh: 他在科學園區的一家製藥公司工作。

example.en: The warehouse stores pharmaceuticals at a controlled temperature.
example.zh: 倉庫在控制的溫度下存放藥品。
